summary: Simon Property Group, L.P. filed Form 8-K to disclose the closing of a €500 million aggregate principal amount of 3.650% guaranteed notes due 2031, issued by its indirect subsidiary Simon Global Development B.V., fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the Operating Partnership. The notes were offered to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. The filing reports customary subscription and fiscal agency agreements, with no terms indicating a special situation. This is a routine debt offering with no acquisition, restructuring, or other corporate event. Watch for ongoing debt servicing.
